expectations.text: NOW: Art. 14 reporting of actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents (since September 11, 2026) via the live ENISA SRP

expectations.text: Open-source software stewards' reporting duty starts December 11, 2027
expectations.evidence: Open-source software stewards are never mentioned

expectations.text: Mentions the Commission's application guidance C(2026) 5252 (July 2026) and/or the Commission CRA FAQs as the interpretive companions

expectations.text: Correctly frames entry into force (December 2024) vs applicability dates, and that reporting applies to products already on the market (no grandfathering out)
